development.scope:
Evaluate a palette corroboration gate on all 15 old consensus outputs.
This is a post-hoc development replay, not an independent control or full detector replay.
development.note: Gate uses existing RGB palette and exactly existing three-observation windows, no threshold search. Colors are not person GT. No new control or production change.

closed_control_now_development_scores.scope: Score palette development outputs against unchanged closed-control labels.
